issues.display_title: Issue #1639: [integration] Retire legacy app-sidemenu for redesigned dashboard routes

Epic: Cleanup & QA

Switch the 4 redesigned routes off the legacy app-sidemenu / data: { sideMenu: true } shell now that they use DashboardShellComponent.

Note: full removal of sidemenu.component waits until Settings is also migrated (tracked as a fast-follow).

Acceptance: My Galleries / Information / Help / Start Creating render only the new shell; no double sidebar; no regressions on routes still using the old sidemenu.

Depends on: the four page-migration epics.

Part of the My Galleries authenticated-surface redesign.
Refs: docs/brainstorm/05-06-2026/my galleries/plan.md · brainstorming.md

Epic: Foundation (integration)

Implement dark/light theme switching driven by a ThemeService.

Scope

  • ThemeService sets data-theme on <html>, persists choice (storage), SSR-safe default.
  • Theme toggle UI in the shared header (always visible).
  • Theme colors the shared shell (everywhere) + marketing bodies. Product page bodies stay light.

Acceptance criteria

  • Toggling switches theme instantly; choice persists across reloads and navigation.
  • No window/document access at module load (SSR-safe); correct default rendered on server.

Testing scenario (QA)

  1. Click the theme toggle → header/footer + marketing page switch to dark; reload → still dark (persisted).
  2. Navigate to a product page (editor/settings) → header/footer dark, page body stays light.
  3. Hard-refresh in dark mode → no flash of light theme before hydration.
  4. Open in a fresh/incognito session → loads with the correct default theme.
